title: Function Arguments and Variable Scope
learning_objectives: You can define default parameter values in functions
You can distinguish between local function variables and global variables

prerequisites_check.question: What is the key principle behind Function Arguments and Variable Scope?
prerequisites_check.explanation: Python requires adhering to clear lexical and semantic rules.

explanation_simple: Variables made inside a recipe belong inside that recipe. When the recipe is finished, those local variables disappear so they do not mix with others.
explanation_technical: Variable lookups follow the LEGB rule (Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in). Fast locals are indexed in PyFrameObject fastlocals array.

worked_examples.title: Default arguments in function calls
worked_examples.code:
def greet(name, greeting="Hello"):
    return f"{greeting}, {name}!"

print(greet("Ada"))
print(greet("Ada", "Good morning"))
